name: LNK (Shortcut) Files
purpose: Auto-created shortcuts to recently opened files/folders, encoding target path, volume serial, and MAC timestamps of the target at time of access.
key_fields: Target MAC timestamps embedded at creation
normal_baseline: Shortcuts correspond to documents/programs the user has opened, consistent with normal work patterns.
anomalies: LNK pointing to a target on removable media matching an unauthorized USBSTOR entry
LNK referencing a file staged in a temp/exfil directory
anti_forensic_notes: Persists after the target file is deleted, preserving path and volume evidence; the TrackerDataBlock MAC address can help attribute the originating machine when a file was moved across systems.
